summary: EQT Infrastructure Company LLC filed an 8-K solely to disclose its transactional net asset value per share as of April 30, 2026, determined by its manager EQT Partners Inc. The filing contains no transaction, merger, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or any other special-situation event. It is a routine periodic NAV disclosure used for share sales and repurchases in a continuously-offered fund structure. No deal terms, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural mechanics are present. This filing is not a corporate event; it is a standard current report updating a fund's net asset value.
